name: Главболгарстрой / Glavbolgarstroy Holding AD (GBS)

Current flagship contracts as главен изпълнител (general contractor): Twin Tower (52,335 m², Sofia), One Park (40,012 m², Sofia), Rodina Residence (862 apartments, Sofia), Residential Park (1,475 apartments / ~296,000 m², Plovdiv, via GBS Homes).

Vertically integrated across infrastructure, residential, commercial, industrial and hospitality construction, with own developer arms (GBS Homes, GBS-Invest)
